# PrenupAnswers

> Plain-English, state-by-state guides, cost breakdowns, and checklists for prenuptial agreements in the United States.

Independent educational resource explaining prenuptial agreement laws, community property vs. equitable distribution rules, asset protection, and realistic legal costs across US states without heavy legalese. Canonical domain: https://www.prenupanswers.com. Last updated: 2026-11-19.
